characters.name: Giske
characters.description: Giske is a lengthy, agile woman with an air of comical mischievousness. Her long limbs aid her swiftness as she frequently outpaces others, contributing to the humorous chaos she often finds herself in. After an unfortunate prank, she sports a bizarre appearance with black soot and talc smeared over her, giving her a devilish, unrecognizable look, which even confounds her. Her hair, likely disheveled due to her antics and actions, adds to her wild look. Giske tends to dress simply, probably in practical, worn clothes that serve her well in her various schemes and pursuits.

characters.name: Enkemand
characters.description: The Enkemand is a cunning character with a somewhat tired demeanor, stemming from Giske's persistent advances. He is average in build, with an appearance befitting a typical farmer or rural worker, likely older given he is an 'Enkemand'. His expressions range from plotting mischief to sheer relief when finally rid of Giske's nagging presence. His attire consists of practical and modest rural clothing, suited for work and comfort.

characters.name: Tyvene
characters.description: The Tyvene (thieves) are a pair of men frantic and comical in their fear of Giske. They are nondescript, with appearances that blend into the forest setting — likely wearing stealthy, dark clothing suitable for their sneaky endeavors. Their expressions are usually wide-eyed with fright and confusion, especially when encountering Giske’s antics.

characters.name: Præsten
characters.description: The Præsten is a comical figure who ends up being swept into the chaos involving Giske. He is clad humorously in a nightcap and slippers, unprepared for the outdoor adventure. His demeanor is one of urgency and reluctance, trying to navigate situations well outside his normal clerical duties. Physically, he is perhaps older and slightly rotund, portraying a classic, pastoral figure.
